summary: Tested 2 new features: (1) Past-date validation for BOTH check-in AND check-out dates when creating bookings, (2) New /api/analytics/source-breakdown endpoint with pie charts for bookings count and revenue by source. All 12 backend tests PASSED. All frontend features verified working.
passed_tests: Backend: test_01_checkin_past_date_rejected - POST /api/bookings returns 400 for past check-in dates
Backend: test_02_checkout_past_date_rejected - POST /api/bookings returns 400 for past check-out dates
Backend: test_03_only_checkout_past_rejected - Check-out before check-in rejected with 400
Backend: test_04_today_checkin_checkout_accepted - Today check-in and future check-out accepted
Backend: test_05_future_dates_accepted - Future check-in and check-out dates accepted
Backend: test_06_source_breakdown_returns_data - GET /api/analytics/source-breakdown returns correct structure
Backend: test_07_source_breakdown_structure - Source breakdown has label, key, bookings, revenue, booking_pct, revenue_pct
Backend: test_08_source_breakdown_with_year_filter - Accepts year query param
Backend: test_11_source_breakdown_with_all_filters - All filters work together
Frontend: Analytics page loads with source breakdown pie charts
Frontend: 'Bookings by Source' pie chart displays with source-bookings-chart testid
Frontend: 'Revenue by Source' pie chart displays with source-revenue-chart testid
Frontend: Source items show with percentages and values (Airbnb 50%, Direct 50%)
Frontend: Check-in date input has min='2026-02-22' (today) for new bookings
Frontend: Check-out date input has min='2026-02-22' for new bookings

checkout_past_date_validation.details: POST /api/bookings now validates BOTH check-in AND check-out dates. Returns 400 with message 'Check-out date cannot be in the past' for past checkout dates.

checkin_past_date_validation.details: POST /api/bookings returns 400 with message 'Check-in date cannot be in the past' for past check-in dates.

source_breakdown_endpoint.details: GET /api/analytics/source-breakdown returns sources array with label, key, bookings, revenue, nights, booking_pct, revenue_pct. Accepts year, month, property_id query params.

bookings_by_source_pie_chart.details: Analytics page shows 'Bookings by Source' pie chart with data-testid='source-bookings-chart'. Shows source name, percentage, and count.

revenue_by_source_pie_chart.details: Analytics page shows 'Revenue by Source' pie chart with data-testid='source-revenue-chart'. Shows source name, percentage, and revenue amount.

date_input_min_attribute.details: Both check-in and check-out inputs in booking form have min attribute set to today for new bookings. Prevents UI selection of past dates.

test_credentials.note: Tests create their own test users/sessions with timestamps for isolation

seed_data_creation: Test creates temporary test users, properties, and bookings - cleaned up after tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: Two new features verified working: (1) Check-out past-date validation added alongside existing check-in validation - backend returns 400 for past dates, frontend has min attribute on both date inputs, (2) New source breakdown analytics endpoint at GET /api/analytics/source-breakdown returns aggregated booking/revenue data by source with pie charts on Analytics page showing Bookings by Source and Revenue by Source. All source percentages and amounts display correctly.
